paragraphs: 🤖 Global AI News Stream - 100% Unmanned Automated AI News Generation Platform 🚀 Fully Automated AI News Ecosystem Global AI News Stream is a completely unmanned AI news auto-generation system that operates 24/7 without human intervention. From web crawling to article writing and image generation, every process is 100% automated. 🎯 Core Feature: Complete Unmanned Operation 🔄 Auto Collection → 🤖 AI Analysis → ✍️ Article Generation → 🎨 Image Creation → 📊 Auto Distribution Every process runs automatically without human touch 💎 Revolutionary Unmanned Technology

Real-time Web Search: 24-hour automated search via Brave Search API Automatic Keyword Extraction: Auto-parsing related keywords from URL input alone Smart Filtering: Auto-selection of HOT news with AI relevance score 90+ points Multi-source Integration: Automatic collection from global AI news sources

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Automated analysis and categorization of collected data Relevance Scoring: 0-100 point automatic evaluation system Trend Detection: Real-time automatic AI trend capture Duplicate Removal: Automatic filtering of duplicate content with smart algorithms
